entries.title: Fundamental Ratio & Valuation Study Lenses Added
entries.summary: Added educational screening filters for trailing P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, ROE, ROCE, Operating Margin, and Debt-to-Equity alongside historical price and volume observation modules.

entries.title: Expanded NSE & BSE Market Universe Segmentation
entries.summary: Added structured universe selectors for NIFTY 50, NIFTY 200, NIFTY 500, All NSE Stocks, and BSE Large Cap, Mid Cap, and Small Cap segments on delayed End-of-Day data.

entries.title: Market Structure & Multi-Factor Observation Tables
entries.summary: Introduced rule-based multi-factor case-study tables combining moving-average alignment, relative strength observation, and historical volatility ranges.
